about:
Caltronics Design & Assembly was founded in 1995 in Stacy, Minnesota, as a family-owned PCB assembly company serving inventors, design engineers, and businesses needing help bringing products to market. The company remains family-owned and operated, with a global presence.

The company provides end-to-end electronic manufacturing services, including electronic design, PCB design, PCB assembly, design for test, design for manufacturing, rapid prototyping, electronic product design, electronics testing, electromechanical assembly, PCB potting, and conformal coating. Production uses equipment such as a MY700 jet printer, selective solder machine, and 3D automated optical inspection, supporting in-house prototyping through production.

Caltronics serves defense and aerospace, medical devices, military and law enforcement, renewable energy, solar, sports and outdoors, automotive, navigation, lighting, and commercial/industrial sectors. Customers range from individual inventors to established companies requiring compliant, precision assemblies.

The company emphasizes "big company experience with small company service," highlighting its ISO 9001:2015 certification, ITAR registration, and deep compliance knowledge as differentiators that enable it to guide projects from concept to final product while clients retain ownership of their intellectual property.
